offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Check your wifi or mobile data. This will load on its own when you're back online.

slow.title: This is taking too long
slow.body: The connection is slow or the server isn't responding. Try again in a while.

server.title: Something went wrong
server.body: It's not your connection: the problem is on our side. Try again in a while.

connection.offline: No connection. You'll see what's already loaded.

unexpected.title: Something broke
unexpected.body: It's not your fault. Go back home to keep listening.
